subject: Peak capacity soft-commit and repricing path
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@perchapps.com>
To: priyom@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:18:00 -0400
Subject: Peak capacity request for next week's campaign

Hi Priyom,

Quick note — we have a major marketing activation scheduled for next Thursday (June 24) and our traffic model shows a ~3x burst over baseline for roughly 48–72 hours, with a taper that could last up to a week. Right now our account is on the standard tier with a conservative concurrency cap.

Can Redwood provision a temporary uplift for the peak window (target: 3x concurrency) and offer a blended overrun price for that period? We need a clear spend ceiling and a short PO/PO# to make finance comfortable. If the uplift can be treated as a soft-commit that converts to a discounted committed minimum if usage stays elevated, that would be ideal.

I attached a short launch plan (perch-launch-plan.pdf) with expected QPS and token estimates.

High level asks:
- Temporary concurrency uplift: 3x for ~10 days (6/23–7/2)
- Blended overrun pricing for the uplift window (single line item our finance team can approve)
- A spend cap or max invoice threshold we can set in advance

Can you get back to me today with options and any PO steps we should follow? We’re on a tight timeline.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Platform, PerchApps
M: +1 415-678-3321
[Attachment: perch-launch-plan.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@perchapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Peak capacity request for next week's campaign

Maya — thanks for the heads up and the launch plan. We can support this; below are three pragmatic options depending on how PerchApps wants to trade cost vs. operational friction.

Option A — Temporary headroom (fastest)- We grant a time-limited concurrency uplift to 3x for the requested window (6/23–7/2). Billing: blended overrun rate for the uplift window on top of your existing plan. No long-term commitment. Needs PO or written approval by EOD to lock the pool.

Option B — Short soft-commit (convertible)- We provision the uplift and create a 30-day soft-commit: if average usage during the uplift exceeds X tokens/day and Perch chooses to convert, we apply a one-time conversion credit and move to a short-term committed slab at a reduced per-token rate. This reduces invoiced unit price by a negotiated percent if converted. Requires PO + signed amendment afterwards.

Option C — Prepaid burst slab (lowest unit cost)- Prepay for a burst slab (pre-agreed token block) at a discounted rate. If consumption is less than the slab, leftover credits roll into a 30-day window. This is the cleanest for finance but needs a single upfront payment.

Proposed commercial (example numbers to accelerate):
- Blended overrun rate during uplift: $0.045 / 1k tokens (vs your current $0.065)
- Convertible discount on commit: 10% off the blended uplift rate if you choose Option B within 14 days post-window
- Prepaid slab discount (Option C): 18% off list for the burst block (min $25k)

Attachments: temp-uplift-proposal.pdf (short SOW + acceptance checklist). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm which option (A/B/C) you prefer and the PO/finance contact + PO#.
2) If A, send us a PO or written approval and we’ll lock the uplift and provide a spend cap you can set in the console.
3) If B or C, Ben will help run the final pricing and Laura will prepare the amendment.

If helpful I can jump on a 20-min call now to close this.

—Priyom
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: temp-uplift-proposal.pdf]

From: Maya Singh <maya@perchapps.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex@perchapps.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Peak capacity request for next week's campaign

Thanks Priyom — option B sounds like the best fit for us. We want the flexibility of a convertible soft-commit in case the traffic sustains, but we also need a firm spend cap during the window.

Our expected peak: ~1,800 QPS sustained for 6–10 hours during the first 48 hours, tapering to ~700 QPS the rest of the week. Token estimate attached and I’ve included a PO stub (perch-po-1234.pdf). Finance wants a single-line blended overrun charge and a hard cap of $40k for the uplift window. Can Redwood set an invoice ceiling and trigger an automated throttle if we hit 90% of that cap?

If you can confirm the conversion discount (10% off the uplift blended rate) and accept the $40k cap, we’re ready to approve.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — can you confirm by EOD?

Maya

[Attachment: perch-po-1234.pdf]

Ben/Laura — forwarding Perch's acceptance of Option B. Key asks: convertible soft-commit, blended overrun single-line charge, and a hard cap at $40k with an automated throttle at 90%. They’ve included a PO stub.

Requesting:
- Ben: can you sign off on a one-time 10% concession on the uplift blended rate (matches the conversion discount we proposed) and confirm we can enforce a $40k invoice ceiling and automated throttle behavior? If we need a cap-exception process, say so.
- Laura: please prepare a short amendment/acceptance that captures the soft-commit language, conversion mechanics, and the spend cap. Keep it minimal — Perch wants quick execution. I’ve attached the temp-uplift-proposal.pdf and the PO from the customer.

If you both approve, I’ll send the formal amendment + DocuSign link to Perch and enable the uplift once we have PO or signed acceptance.

Thanks — P.
